description: Use when the user wants to see the fields, clauses and legal basis of one template before filling it. Get one standard template by id (fields, clauses or markdown body metadata, legal_basis with [K] sources). Same as GET /api/templates/{id}. Partner-only templates need the partner key. Free, read-only.

template_id.description: Template id from list_templates, e.g. es_auction_poa_v2 or es_contrato_arras_v1.

name: get_template
title: Get a document template
